notes: Its synagogue was taken down in the 1840s for the approaches to the South Eastern Railway; a new one was built in 1847–48.

name: Jews' Orphan Asylum

notes: Melbourne branch of the Anglo-Jewish Association (London, 1871).

name: St Kilda Hebrew Congregation
notes: Held its first services at a hall in Grey Street in September 1871.

name: New Synagogue, Sydney
notes: Building fund for the synagogue that became the Great Synagogue, Elizabeth Street (consecrated 1878).

name: United Friends Jewish Benefit Society
notes: Established 5614–1854 according to the notice of 13 October 1871. The notice states an invested fund of £400; this is not a donation total.

name: Auckland Hebrew School
notes: Named in the prize-distribution report published 25 April 1873. No foundation date inferred from the reference to an eighth annual presentation.

name: School 180 (Jewish)
notes: Name as printed in The Australian Israelite, 18 April 1873, p. 5. No modern institutional identification has been inferred.

name: Toowoomba Synagogue Building Fund
notes: Fundraising appeal by the elders of the congregation, The Australian Israelite, 28 November 1873, p. 113. The proposed building is not given a foundation date.

name: Ballarat Hebrew and Sabbath-schools
notes: Name from the examination report of 10 April 1874; no date of foundation inferred.

name: Jewish Publication Society of America
notes: Corporate name as written in the user-supplied charter. The charter date is not treated as the founding date of the society.

name: Hebrew Sunday School Society of Philadelphia
notes: Organization named in Temple University’s record for SCRC 50, Box 1, Folder 3. The opening ledger describes a school opened for Jewish children by the Female H. B. Society; this historical wording is retained in the first list notes without inventing a separate organizational identity.

name: Hebrew Education Society of Philadelphia
notes: Organization whose sixty-fifth annual report for 1913 is bound with the Hebrew Sunday School Society report in SCRC 50, Box 2, Folder 8. Kept distinct from the Hebrew Sunday School Society.

name: Federation of Jewish Charities of Philadelphia
notes: Explicit heading of the historical memorial/endowment register in the 1915 Hebrew Sunday School Society annual report, scans 029–030. Kept distinct from the Society; also named as institutional appropriator in its treasury receipts.

name: Keren Hayesod (Palestine Foundation Fund)
notes: Zionist fundraising organization; Calcutta collections listed here.

name: Earthquake Relief Fund (Palestine)
